title: Freeway World
content: Just discovered this reddit and wanted to share a location I frequent in my dreams. I’m always in the car as a passenger and there are just freeways stacked as far as the eye can see, just overpasses everywhere you can’t even see ground. The sky reminds me of roku city, like a super purple dusk. It’s boring and I don’t think I even talk, just stare out the window. I hate going there, has anyone else ever been?
